Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. PortBridge is in the final stages of vendor selection for our inference layer (we've been benchmarking Redwood vs NebulaAI and CloudRunOps). Two asks before procurement signs off: a) a firm price-match option against NebulaAI's quoted MRR/usage bands, and b) clarity on packaging for our hybrid deployment (hosted + VPC private endpoints) — specifically: seat vs consumption bundling, egress allowances, and any start-up/onboarding credits.

I've attached the RFP and the TCO sheet NebulaAI shared (PortBridge_RFP_v2.pdf, tco-comparison-20260914.xlsx). Procurement wants a simple, auditable comparison they can take to finance by Friday. If you can send a concise matched offer and migration incentives (credits or free ramp) that would be ideal.

Also: our security team wants the migration rollback guarantees callout (we need a low-risk escape clause). Happy to hop on a quick 30m to align.

Best,
Danielle Rios
Senior Procurement Manager
PortBridge

Hi Danielle — appreciate the clear ask and the RFP.

Short answer: yes — we can present a structured price-match and a low-friction migration package that preserves your latency SLOs while meeting NebulaAI's price bands. I'll outline the headline offer below and attach a formal matched quote. If the bullets look right, we can get legal/finance to iron the term-sheet and I can send a DocuSign link.

Headline matched offer (initial):
- Pricing: 12-month term matched to NebulaAI's quoted effective unit costs (we'll attach line-by-line comparisons).
- Packaging: Hybrid bundle — base monthly committed capacity (dedicated pool for predictable traffic) + overage consumption pricing. Seat licensing removed; seats rolled into committed capacity to simplify invoicing.
- Migration incentives: 8 weeks of onboarding credits (50% of committed capacity consumption credited) + 90 days of reduced egress fees for first 10TB.
- Escape / rollback: 30-day rollback window with preserved data export and runbook assistance; sandbox migration plan included.
- Technical constraints: prefix KV-cache can be warmed for migration; model-variant fallbacks available if your peak tails exceed committed throughput.

Next steps: 1) Can you confirm the NebulaAI effective unit cost reference line in the spreadsheet we should match? 2) If confirmed, I'll circulate a matched-offer quote (PDF) and a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.

I'll also loop in our solutions lead to confirm the hybrid connectivity details.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: matched-offer-quote.pdf

Subject: Matched offer and migration plan — PortBridge (formal)

Hi Danielle / Evan — thanks for the patience while we pulled the numbers together. Per our conversation and the spreadsheet you provided, attached is a concise matched offer and the handoff runbook. Highlights below (see attached matched-offer-quote.pdf for line-by-line comparison):

- Contract: 12-month matched term (effective unit pricing matched to NebulaAI reference for the 750k token band).
- Billing & Packaging: Hybrid package = committed capacity (equivalent to 60% of your peak baseline) + consumption overage by effective unit. No separate seat fees; seats included in committed capacity. Simple sample invoices attached (two scenarios).
- Migration incentives: 8 weeks onboarding credit = 50% credit on committed consumption applied to first two invoices (estimated value $48,000). 90 days reduced egress (50% discount up to 10TB).
- SLA & rollback: 30-day rollback window from go-live with runbook-driven export assistance. We will escrow migration runbooks and provide a fixed-hours technical support package (20 hours) for rollback assistance. Liability will remain within standard T&Cs; we can put a narrow migration-specific indemnity in the sideletter limited to documented implementation errors (Markus to provide final wording).
- Technical plan: Private VPC peering for control plane, TLS for data plane, staged rollout (2-week smoke, 4-week warm/live). We will pre-warm KV-cache for frequent prefixes and provide a fallback model-variant pool during initial ramp.

Attachments: matched-offer-quote.pdf, PortBridge_migration-runbook_v1.pdf
Links: DocuSign: https://docuview.example/ds/PB-Match-2026, internal deal: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CRM-2345
